purpose: Single selectable tab trigger inside a tabs composite that registers with the parent context and controls a matching tab-panel or caller-owned panel id.
useWhen: Declaring one tab heading inside a tabs ancestor with a stable value identifier.
Pairing one-to-one with a tab-panel that shares the same value to wire aria-controls.
Pointing multiple tab triggers at a caller-owned panel with the controls prop.

avoidWhen.reason: Used outside a tabs ancestor — the component throws at construction.
Rendering a generic action button — use button instead.
